# Atrium Ljungberg missar estimat – Hexagon köper mjukvarubolag

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon, recorded on the last trading day of the week. Pareto engineering analyst Anders Roslund is very bullish on Swedish industrials exposed to data centers, naming Atlas Copco, ABB, Munters and Alfa Laval as buys going into a reporting season he expects to be solid but not exceptional. Fund manager Inge Heydorn says the FT report that OpenAI's revenue is lower than thought is just a gross-versus-net accounting difference and that AI growth is intact. Property analyst Niklas Wetterling calls Atrium Ljungberg's Q3 report weak, with rising vacancies and higher average interest rates ahead. Elsewhere, Hexagon rose on an acquisition and a JP Morgan upgrade, while Telia and Tele2 fell on SpaceX's move into mobile.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ABB — ABB | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Guest analyst Roslund (Pareto): data-center orders growing >100%, 12-24 month delivery times, 5-year growth 'kassaskåpssäkert'.

#### Reasoning

Electrification (~50% of ABB) has orders up ~60% and data-center-related growth above 100%. Long lead times give visibility on sales 12-24 months ahead. Roslund argues the market still prices ABB too close to ordinary engineering growth, so the valuation is not demanding. This is a guest analyst's view, not the hosts'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a valuation crash or financial meltdown in AI hits data-center buildout
- if electrification order growth slows sharply
- if customers stop pre-securing power equipment

> *"Det är därför jag säger att det är kassaskåpssäkert. ABB kommer att ha en betydligt bättre försäljningstillväxt de kommande fem åren."*

---

### 🟢 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Roslund: vacuum pump orders up 59% in Q2 and expected to stay there in Q3/Q4; valuation slightly above the 5-year average but not demanding.

#### Reasoning

Pareto's Roslund expects Q2's very strong vacuum pump order level to repeat in Q3/Q4 and sees no change in AI demand since Q2. Data-center and chip investment should stay strong for years. The stock is near record highs and trades a little above its 5-year average multiple, but he says higher growth justifies it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI valuations crash
- if vacuum pump orders fall back from Q2 levels
- if the Q3 outlook for demand weakens

> *"Man kan köpa Atlas Copco och man kan köpa ABB som också har elektrifiering i botten"*

---

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Roslund: biggest data-center exposure (~50% of sales); share collapse is due to company-specific production problems; one of the most undervalued engineering stocks.

#### Reasoning

The share price fall comes from production ramp problems in one product group and worries about cooling technology changes, not from AI demand. With about half of sales tied to data centers, Roslund sees deep undervaluation if execution improves.

#### Sell Triggers

- if production problems persist
- if cooling technology shifts away from Munters' products

> *"Men jag tycker att Munters kanske är ett av de mest undervärderade bolagen man kan hitta i verkstadssektorn nu."*

---

### 🟢 ALFA — Alfa Laval | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

On Pareto's buy list; heat exchangers for data-center cooling and energy recovery.

#### Reasoning

Alfa Laval's energy division sells heat exchangers that are essential for cooling data centers and recovering energy. Roslund is very positive and the stock is on Pareto's buy list.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-center capex slows
- if the industrial recovery stalls

> *"Jag är väldigt positiv. Vi har Alfa Laval också på vår köplista."*

---

### ⛔ ATRLJ-B — Atrium Ljungberg | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Analyst Wetterling: Q3 8% below consensus, rising vacancy, weak net letting, interest costs set to rise as hedges roll off.

#### Reasoning

Net letting in the existing portfolio has been negative in 7 of the last 8 quarters, so vacancy will likely keep rising. New letting volumes are down ~60%. Loan-to-value (LTV) is near its internal target while big project capex lies ahead. Interest-rate fixing has fallen to 2.2 years from about 4, so average rates will rise. The stock is already down 33%.

#### Sell Triggers

- reverse view if net letting turns positive
- reverse view if vacancy starts falling
- reverse view if rates fall meaningfully

> *"Det indikerar att vakansen även framgent kommer fortsätta och ticka lite uppåt."*

---

### 🟠 HEXA-B — Hexagon | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Highly profitable US software acquisition seen as positive even initially; JP Morgan upgraded to overweight; shares up >3%.

#### Reasoning

Roslund likes that Hexagon keeps pursuing acquisitions; the target has a ~40% EBITDA margin but was bought at ~10x sales. JP Morgan, a cited analyst, upgraded the stock to overweight. AI disruption fears still hang over software stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI erodes software earnings
- if the acquisition integration disappoints

> *"Men det ser ju på pappret ut som att det är en positiv affär även initialt."*

---

### 🟠 TELIA — Telia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

SpaceX/Starlink entering mobile could weigh on how telecom operators are valued; Telia seen as more at risk than Ericsson.

#### Reasoning

Roslund says Starlink will not hit earnings for years but could dampen valuation multiples for operators. Shares fell ~2.5% on the news.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Starlink launches competing mobile service in the Nordics

> *"Telia och Tele2 är kanske mer i fara än vad Ericsson är men vi behöver kanske inte spekulera där."*

---

### 🟠 TEL2-B — Tele2 | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Same SpaceX competition worry as Telia; down ~2.5%.

#### Reasoning

Satellite-to-mobile competition could weigh on operator valuations over the long term, though there is no near-term hit to earnings.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Starlink competes in Nordic mobile

> *"Telia och Tele2 är kanske mer i fara än vad Ericsson är"*

---
